summary_en: ¥72/share annual dividend (¥36 interim + ¥36 year-end); ¥2 increase vs. prior FY12/26 guidance of ¥70/share. Payout ratio target ~70% under medium-term plan. FY12/26 earnings upgraded: operating profit +6.9%, net income +2.6%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of FY12/26 Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Interim Dividend and Year-End Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Toagosei revised its FY12/26 (calendar year 2026) earnings guidance upward on 31 July 2026. Operating profit is now forecast at ¥15.5bn (+6.9% vs. prior guidance of ¥14.5bn), consolidated net income at ¥11.8bn (+2.6% vs. ¥11.5bn), and EPS at ¥111.22 vs. prior ¥108.56. The board approved an interim dividend of ¥36/share (¥1 higher than the prior guided ¥35) as of the 30 June 2026 record date, effective 4 September 2026. For the year-end dividend, the board raised guidance by ¥1 to ¥36/share (vs. prior ¥35). As a result, the full-year dividend is now projected at ¥72/share, ¥2 above the prior FY12/26 guidance of ¥70/share and ¥7 above FY12/25 actual of ¥65/share. The company states that stable dividend continuation and enhanced shareholder returns are key management priorities, and the medium-term plan targets an average consolidated payout ratio of approximately 70%. The earnings upgrade was driven by strong semiconductor product sales, increased volume in the polymer-oligomer and resin-processing segments, and improved profitability in the polymer-oligomer business.
